## discord-rpc

This library originally came from [PCSX2](https://github.com/PCSX2/pcsx2/tree/master/3rdparty/discord-rpc) which came from the original [discord-rpc](https://github.com/discord/discord-rpc) repository. It has been modified to work with myMCpp.
